Package org.springframework.test.web.servlet.result

@NullMarked package org.springframework.test.web.servlet.result
Contains built-in ResultMatcher and ResultHandler implementations.

使用MockMvcResultMatchers和MockMvcResultHandlers来访问这些实现的实例。
